# Shifen
> Shifen provides AI-powered customer support and sales agents for websites, messaging, and voice channels.

Shifen focuses on deploying AI agents for customer-facing conversations, with documentation covering setup, integrations, channels, analytics, and operational workflows.

## Documentation
- [Docs Home](https://docs.shifen.com/): Main documentation hub for Shifen platform setup, usage, and administration.
- [Getting Started](https://docs.shifen.com/getting-started): Introductory guide to launching and configuring Shifen AI agents.
- [Overview](https://docs.shifen.com/overview): Product overview and core concepts for understanding the Shifen platform.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.shifen.com/quickstart): Fast path to initial deployment and first working agent.
- [FAQ](https://docs.shifen.com/faq): Answers to common questions about setup, features, and operations.

## AI Agent Setup
- [Create an Agent](https://docs.shifen.com/agents/create-an-agent): Steps for creating and configuring a new AI agent.
- [Agent Settings](https://docs.shifen.com/agents/settings): Configuration options for behavior, branding, and operational controls.
- [Knowledge Base](https://docs.shifen.com/agents/knowledge-base): Manage source content used to ground agent responses.
- [Prompts](https://docs.shifen.com/agents/prompts): Define instructions and prompting behavior for agent conversations.
- [Handoffs](https://docs.shifen.com/agents/handoffs): Configure escalation from AI agents to human support teams.
- [Testing](https://docs.shifen.com/agents/testing): Validate agent behavior before production deployment.

## Channels
- [Website Chat](https://docs.shifen.com/channels/website-chat): Deploy Shifen agents on websites through embedded chat experiences.
- [WhatsApp](https://docs.shifen.com/channels/whatsapp): Connect and operate AI agents on WhatsApp conversations.
- [Instagram](https://docs.shifen.com/channels/instagram): Use Shifen agents for Instagram messaging workflows.
- [Facebook Messenger](https://docs.shifen.com/channels/facebook-messenger): Integrate AI support into Facebook Messenger conversations.
- [Voice](https://docs.shifen.com/channels/voice): Configure voice-based AI interactions for phone and call workflows.
- [Email](https://docs.shifen.com/channels/email): Manage AI-assisted customer communication over email channels.

## Integrations
- [Integrations Overview](https://docs.shifen.com/integrations): Directory of supported integrations and connection workflows.
- [Shopify](https://docs.shifen.com/integrations/shopify): Connect Shopify data and workflows to Shifen agents.
- [Zendesk](https://docs.shifen.com/integrations/zendesk): Sync Shifen with Zendesk for support operations and ticketing.
- [HubSpot](https://docs.shifen.com/integrations/hubspot): Integrate CRM data and automation with HubSpot.
- [Slack](https://docs.shifen.com/integrations/slack): Send notifications and operational updates into Slack.
- [Zapier](https://docs.shifen.com/integrations/zapier): Automate workflows between Shifen and external business tools.

## Analytics and Operations
- [Analytics](https://docs.shifen.com/analytics): Monitor conversations, outcomes, and performance metrics across agents.
- [Conversation Logs](https://docs.shifen.com/analytics/conversation-logs): Review historical conversations for quality and troubleshooting.
- [Reports](https://docs.shifen.com/analytics/reports): Access reporting views for operational and business performance.
- [Team Management](https://docs.shifen.com/operations/team-management): Manage users, roles, and workspace permissions.
- [Inbox](https://docs.shifen.com/operations/inbox): Handle live conversations and human follow-up workflows.
- [Notifications](https://docs.shifen.com/operations/notifications): Configure alerts and operational notifications for teams.

## API and Developer Resources
- [API Overview](https://docs.shifen.com/api): Introduction to Shifen developer capabilities and API usage.
- [Authentication](https://docs.shifen.com/api/authentication): Learn how to authenticate requests to the Shifen API.
- [Agents API](https://docs.shifen.com/api/agents): Programmatically create and manage AI agents.
- [Conversations API](https://docs.shifen.com/api/conversations): Access conversation data and interaction records through the API.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.shifen.com/api/webhooks): Subscribe to Shifen events and automate downstream workflows.
- [Rate Limits](https://docs.shifen.com/api/rate-limits): Understand request limits and API usage constraints.

## Help and Support
- [Help Center](https://docs.shifen.com/help): Support resources for troubleshooting and platform assistance.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.shifen.com/help/troubleshooting): Resolve common issues with setup, integrations, and channels.
- [Contact Support](https://docs.shifen.com/help/contact-support): Reach the Shifen support team for direct assistance.
- [Status](https://status.shifen.com/): Service status and incident updates for Shifen systems.
- [Security](https://shifen.com/security): Security practices and platform trust information.

- [Homepage](https://shifen.com/): Main product site for Shifen AI customer support platform.
- [Pricing](https://shifen.com/pricing): Plan and pricing information for Shifen products and usage.

- [Blog](https://shifen.com/blog): Articles, announcements, and product updates from the Shifen team.

- [Contact](https://shifen.com/contact): General contact page for sales and business inquiries.
